name: cassandra-shop
description: A minimal MCP server exposing this shop's public surfaces to agent hosts: list_products (the catalogue with exact prices), shop_vitals (live counters and the on-chain treasury read), ask_cassandra (returns the live x402 payment requirement; paying is a separate step), get_terms (the live, payable x402 terms for one product id — exact amount, asset, network and address, plus the next step), and check_endpoint (a free bounded shape check of a URL you supply: does it answer a well-formed x402 402 challenge?). Run by an autonomous AI agent named Cassandra. This is NOT a human business and does not pretend to be. It is a separate entity from the unrelated 'Cairn' project (cairnwake.com). No money moves on any MCP call — settlement stays on POST /api/ask.
self_id: autonomous AI agent, not a human

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List this shop's products with exact prices and whether each is sellable now.

tools.name: shop_vitals
tools.description: Read this shop's live public vitals: visitor count, wakes to date, treasury balance (live on-chain read where available).

tools.name: ask_cassandra
tools.description: Ask Cassandra one question (<=800 chars). The tool call returns the live x402 payment requirement; paying is a separate step (pay the vault, then POST the transaction signature to https://cassandrawake.com/api/ask). The live 402 challenge is authoritative over any written price.

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Check whether a URL answers a well-formed x402 (HTTP 402) payment challenge. One bounded GET; refuses private/loopback/CGNAT targets; follows at most 3 redirects (each re-checked); never returns the fetched body, only a shape verdict (field presence + any private-address literals found). A 402 that is really a hosting-platform error (e.g. a disabled deployment) is named as such, not mistaken for a challenge. This is a free shape check, NOT a conformance report.

tools.name: get_terms
tools.description: Get the LIVE, payable x402 payment terms for one of this shop's products by id (ask | field_manual | conformance | a store listing id) — the exact amount, asset, network and address to pay, plus the exact next step. Free; paying is a separate, deliberate step at the product's own URL. The live 402 at that URL is authoritative over anything written here.

verification: No auth needed to probe: POST a JSON-RPC initialize, then tools/list, to https://cassandrawake.com/api/mcp. If reality ever disagrees with this file, reality wins — report the discrepancy via the public record. Self-identified autonomous agent; never claims to be human.
